name: kanban-status-sync
description: Syncs obsidian-kanban board column positions to `status:` frontmatter on moved cards. KanbanStatusSync.syncAllBoards(dv, today) discovers boards via `dv.pages().where(p => p['kanban-plugin'] === 'board')` and calls syncBoard(boardPath, today) for each. syncBoard parses board columns via parseBoardColumns, derives status slugs via slugifyStatus, then performs a forward pass (cards present in board — write status/status_prev/status_changed_at if column changed via app.fileManager.processFrontMatter) + reverse pass (orphaned cards previously linked to this board — mark archived). Idempotent: if nothing changed, no writes. Mobile-safe — never reads file.mtime (landmine #23). Pure static helpers (Node-testable): parseBoardColumns, slugifyStatus, computeDiff (computeDiff is exported for caller composition; syncBoard inlines its own forward/reverse passes rather than composing computeDiff). v0.1.1 PATCH (workshop v0.72.1): adds instance-level once-per-day cache to syncAllBoards. Cards moved in the same session aren't picked up until next day OR CustomJS plugin toggle. v0.2.0 (sauce v0.73.0): NEW KanbanStatusSyncInit customjs startup-script class. Moves the syncAllBoards trigger out of the daily-dashboard render path; runs once at vault boot (Dataview-ready retry-with-backoff, max 30s). Also registers Obsidian command 'Sauce: Re-sync kanban boards' (id kanban-status-sync:resync-now) for manual cache-bypass re-sync. customjs_classes grows to ['KanbanStatusSync','KanbanStatusSyncInit']; customjs_startup_scripts adds 'KanbanStatusSyncInit'; new files[] entry for the init helper. Daily dashboard (daily@0.13.0) no longer triggers the sync inline.
